asset_authoring.ui.title: Asset authoring: ui
asset_authoring.ui.description: Create/edit/save/read-back tasks for one Unreal asset-authoring domain.

task_refs.description: Create a Widget Blueprint, add and style a TextBlock, compile/save it, and read the widget tree back
Create a CommonActivatableWidget, convert/configure CommonTextBlock text, compile/save, and audit CommonUI wiring
Create a CommonUI input-action DataTable, add keyboard/gamepad glyph rows, save, and read the rows back
Create a Widget Blueprint, add a TextBlock, author a multi-key UWidgetAnimation, save, and read animation tracks back
Create a Widget Blueprint, author Bezier and spring animation tracks, add timed animation events, bind a widget event to an animation, save, and read animation tracks back
Build a Widget Blueprint from a UISpec document, save it, dump the UISpec back, and verify the generated widget tree
Create a Widget Blueprint, apply CanvasPanel slot edits, set allowlisted TextBlock properties, expose widget variables, save, and read back tree/properties/variables
Create a Widget Blueprint, convert a Button to CommonButtonBase, create/apply a CommonButtonStyle, save it, and audit styled CommonUI state
Create saved UMG template Widget Blueprints for menu, dialog, loading, inventory, save slots, and HUD element layouts, then read each generated tree back
Create a dialog Widget Blueprint, convert text and border widgets to CommonUI variants, create CommonText/CommonBorder style assets, apply them, save, and read back the styled tree
Create a CommonActivatableWidget and CommonTabListWidget asset, add CommonUI container/content widgets, author navigation rules, save, and read the authored tree/navigation back
Create an entry Widget Blueprint and a ListView container, configure the ListView entry class and item size, save both assets, and read the list widget back
Create a Widget Blueprint, add nested panels and a child widget, rename and move the child, remove the empty panel, save, and read the final widget tree back
Create a CommonUI input-action DataTable and Widget Blueprint, bind a UCommonActionWidget to the row, save, and audit the widget binding
Create a CommonUI pause-menu scaffold with an action table, save it, and read back widget tree, navigation, focus, and CommonUI audit state
Create a Widget Blueprint with two animations, remove one animation, save, and verify only the retained animation remains
Create a Widget Blueprint and UI-domain shadow parent material, apply a saved box-shadow MaterialInstance to a target widget, save, and read back the inserted shadow widget and MIC parameters
Create a Widget Blueprint with Image, Border, and TextBlock widgets, apply set_image/set_brush/set_font styling edits, save it, and dump the UI spec to read back brush/font/image content
Create saved UMG settings-panel and notification-toast template Widget Blueprints, then read both widget trees back

Create and reload a deterministic CanvasPanel Widget Blueprint, then prove reflection-backed UMG/CommonUI type discovery, type/property/event/binding schemas, accessibility lint, layout audit/measurement, and canonical UISpec fingerprinting
Create and reload CommonUI numeric text, rotator, animated switcher, list, carousel, hardware visibility, lazy-image, and load-guard widgets, then inspect Common framework and messaging contracts
Build a Widget Blueprint from canonical UISpec, plan and apply a confirm-gated owner-action text patch, reload the package, and prove the desired spec converges with a required diff
Create and reload a UMG float animation, plan/apply one delta key, remap its binding GUID to a resident replacement widget, then prove overview, timeline, sampled values, and full track readback
